name: Masterful Sabotage (Ex)
body:
Prerequisite: Saboteur 8

Benefit: The saboteur is especially proficient at disabling traps, even among other saboteurs. Whenever she disarms a trap using Disable Device, she can bypass it even if her check did not exceed the DC by 10 or more. If it is a magic trap that allows specific creatures to pass it without danger, she can modify which creatures it allows to pass, adding her allies and restricting enemies if she desires.
